classification.legacyApplicationRuntimeCode: Only after refactor value exhausted: old_version.zip with original repository-relative paths and verified restoration, never system Trash as a shortcut.
classification.importantCredentials: Retain. Never infer key backup/custody from public keys; no disposal under cleanup permission.
classification.nonApplicationNonCredentialExhaustedMate: After individual review, system Trash with SHA256/original path map/restoration evidence. Owner decides permanent deletion; do not empty Trash.
classification.documents: Owner will write new-version documentation; old age, old version or planned rewrite alone does not establish exhausted reference/maintenance/privacy/license value.
classification.activePrivacyLicensingReleaseOrMaintenan: Retain while obligations remain. Published release assets/tags and protected README/approved images are not automatically retired.
classification.ordinaryOwnRegenerableBuildOutputs: O33 bounded temporary-workspace policy, separately from source-code archive and document retirement; never silently extend to other software or device data.

gate: read and classify exact candidates; do not select by broad directory or age glob
confirm no active caller/reference or ongoing maintenance/refactor obligation
do not change protected README/approved appearance merely to remove a referenced document
private contents remain protected in Trash; use an own restricted container if existing Trash permissions are broader, without changing unrelated system permissions
record precise original path mapping and bytes/SHA before move; verify restorable contents after move
failure stops or restores original locations; never fall back to irreversible deletion
moving to same-filesystem Trash does not reclaim physical disk space
newVersionUserDocs: owner will rewrite; this policy is an engineering retirement record, not replacement user documentation
